sample_size_limitation_warning: CRITICAL: Dataset contains only ~50 images per target class (244 unique total). This very small sample size is insufficient for training a production classifier. Severe risk of overfitting to capture conditions. Independent field validation on external datasets (such as Paddy Doctor) is strictly required before any in-field use.
deduplication_methodology: SHA-256 byte-level digest matching. Exact duplicate files were identified and excluded from split generation to prevent cross-split data leakage. NOTE: SHA-256 cannot detect perceptually similar images, burst shots, or slight variations in angle/illumination.
